sources.observation: Entering the land movement loop calls checkmoneypool before destination input and passability, so pooled wealth is resolved even when the eventual movement attempt is blocked.

Without banking, question 6 offers distribution; accepting opens Swap, declining skips it, and both paths clear every remaining pooled denomination before returning to the caller, which continues ordinary movement processing.

The internal forward-move fallback repeats the no-bank guard: accepting question 6 opens Swap, clears the remainder, redraws, and returns before coordinate mutation; declining clears the pool and continues. Ordinary land and dungeon input normally call checkmoneypool before reaching this fallback.
Dungeon movement validates a nonzero direction and fatigue before checkmoneypool, but resolves the pool before camp/service clearing, wall passability, and movement time.
The question dialog quiets every channel and requests sound 20005 before returning No as zero or Yes as one. The text for STR# 135 entry 6 is not present in the committed source.
Direct Swap entry quiets every channel, requests sound 3003 unless reduced sound is enabled, supports Pool, Share, and exact transfers, and requests sound 141 on Done.

branches.outcome: Clear every pooled denomination and continue the original movement attempt.
Open Swap, clear every unassigned remainder when Swap closes, then continue the ordinary land or dungeon movement caller. The internal moveparty fallback has a distinct early-return branch.

expectedTrace: detect nonzero pooled gold, gems, or jewelry without banking
quiet existing channels and request question sound 20005
persist one typed yes-or-no boundary with the original direction
decline by clearing the pool and resolving that direction once
or accept by opening typed Swap with sound 3003
apply Pool, Share, and exact transfers through core economy rules
persist every distribution mutation and pending response
close with sound 141, clear the remainder, and resume the saved ordinary movement
unknowns: The exact Classic question wording is stored in a resource string table not present in the pinned source tree; Realmz 2.0 uses explicitly synthetic wording until an authoritative resource or runtime observation is available.
Realmz 2.0 has no separately exposed caller corresponding to the internal moveparty fallback's accept-and-return branch; it is not substituted for ordinary checkmoneypool travel.
